title: Verify M9-C3 (observability/connector-recovery/ops-controls/soak) against the deployed release
objective: Mark M9-C3 VERIFIED with real deployment evidence. A genuine, supervised deployment now exists: systemd unit `foundry-ledger.service` runs the installed qualified wheel (eigen-foundry-council 0.1.0, sha256 b786da8a; installed digest sha256 f6ece89a) from /opt/foundry/venv, wired to live Postgres (foundry db via FOUNDRY_LEDGER_DSN), and runs a ReleaseManifest record -> 3-round soak -> persistent supervised heartbeat loop emitting observability to journald. Crash-recovery proven (SIGKILL -> systemd restart in <4s -> new release record; service returns to active). C3's observability (journald + Observability.snapshot), connector recovery (ConnectorHealth gse162256 rows=5 healthy), operational controls (systemd supervision + restart), alerts/soak (3 rounds all_ok) all pass against the exact deployed release. C6 is recorded separately by FWI-M9-028; M9 stays PARTIAL here.
forbidden_actions: commit directly to a protected baseline
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action
commit a real API key, DSN password, or signing secret to the repository
mark C6 VERIFIED in this work item (recorded separately by FWI-M9-028)

acceptance_criteria.description: M9-C3 recorded VERIFIED with RELEASE_EVIDENCE pointing at the deployed release (deploy/ + soak evidence).
M9-C6 left for FWI-M9-028; M9 stays PARTIAL.
